side_a: Total groundwater abstraction in 2023 was 200 million m3
side_b: NPC's report text gives about 180 million m3 for 2023
explanation: 180 is the agricultural wells' share of the 200 total, so the two figures measure different things

trigger_terms: abstraction fell;abstraction dropped;abstraction declined;pumping fell;decline in abstraction
side_a: Abstraction is estimated at 200 million m3 in 2023
side_b: It was 250 million m3 a year in 2019-2022
explanation: Kahramaa revised the estimate using groundwater modelling, so the fall is a change in the estimate, not proven lower pumping

side_a: Desalination supplied 63% of all water produced in 2023
side_b: Over 99.9% of Qatar's drinking water supply is desalinated
explanation: 63% is of all water production, including groundwater pumped for farms; 99.9% is of drinking water only (news report)

trigger_terms: wells on farms;agricultural wells;number of wells
side_a: The farm census table counts 4564 wells on farms in 2023
side_b: Kahramaa officials have cited more than 6500 agricultural wells
source_b: Gulf Times interview, not yet in AquaMaa's database
explanation: The sources count differently; the census counts wells on registered farms, working or not

trigger_terms: times the recharge;times recharge;times natural recharge;3-5 times;3 to 5 times

explanation: 3-5 times matches the 2019-2022 estimate of 250 million m3; the revised 2023 estimate gives 2.7 times recharge

explanation: The averaging period was extended to 2023, which lowered the estimate
